references.text: Refers to 'water of purification' (מֵי נִדָּה) used for cleansing from impurity, the same expression as in Num 31:23
Describes the use of water of purification to cleanse from impurity, parallel to the cleansing ritual in Num 31:23
Concerns the cleansing of objects by water, parallel to the cleansing of objects that cannot withstand fire in Num 31:23
Refers to the cleansing of clay and copper vessels, including the use of fire and water for purification
Concerns the cleansing of clay and wooden vessels by water, parallel to the cleansing of objects in Num 31:23
Prophetic text about cleansing through fire, symbolizing refinement and purification
Refers to refining in fire as an image of cleansing, parallel to the fire-cleansing in Num 31:23
Compares the Lord to a refiner's fire that purifies, parallel to the fire-cleansing in Num 31:23
Refers to faith being tested by fire as an image of refinement and cleansing
Uses fire as an image for testing and cleansing the works of faith
